segments.text: O Prayſe the lorde all ye heathen: prayſe him al ye nacions.
For his mercifull kindnes is euer more and more to warde vs: and the trueth of the Lorde endureth for euer.
Glory be to the father, and to the ſonne: and to the holy goſt.
As it was in the beginnyng, is nowe, and euer ſhalbe: worlde without ende. Amen.
